title: AFP Marks 36 Years of Code of Conduct, Honors Excellence in Service
intro_html: The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) marked the 36th Year of the AFP Code of Conduct and recognized excellence in service during a flag-raising ceremony held today, here. The ceremony was presided over by AFP Vice Chief of Staff Lieutenant General Rommel P. Roldan.

Peralta PA,  pose with members of the AFP Cavaliers Basketball Team in recognition of their championship in the 2026 UNTV Cup during the ceremony held on October 5, 2026, at Camp Aguinaldo.
body_html:
CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City - The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) marked the 36th Year of the AFP Code of Conduct and recognized excellence in service during a flag-raising ceremony held today, here. The ceremony was presided over by AFP Vice Chief of Staff Lieutenant General Rommel P. Roldan.

The celebration underscored the AFP’s continuing commitment to uphold integrity, professionalism, and ethical conduct as essential foundations of military service. Personnel renewed their pledge of allegiance to the AFP Code of Conduct, reaffirming their duty to serve with honor, accountability, and dedication.

LtGen Roldan also conferred the Initiated Status Awards on the Dental Service Center, AFP, and the Veterinary Service Center, AFP, in recognition of their contributions under the AFP Transformation Roadmap and Institutionalization Program. The ceremony likewise featured the awarding of the AFP Cavaliers Basketball Team and the handover of the Educational Benefit System Office, AFP, support proceeds from the Major Service Gold Courses.

The activities highlighted the AFP’s continuing pursuit of institutional excellence and transformation while strengthening a culture anchored on integrity, service, and commitment to the Filipino people.

Photos by Cpl Luna PA / PAOAFP
